purpose: Throwaway original-art direction comparison for the transforming spirit; pending human verdict.

variants.name: Inked cutout
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original game-art direction study, a single landscape comparison sheet for a desktop-browser side-scrolling elemental Metroidvania demo.
Primary request: create an original visual direction called 'Inked cutout'. This is an early concept, not a final sprite sheet. Bold hand-inked cut-paper 2D game art: clean organic silhouettes, restrained chunky contour lines, flat layered shapes, just two or three shading tones per material, subtle paper grain. Visibly simple parts that could pivot and swap in modular cutout animation. Charming, strange, tactile, NOT pixel art and NOT painterly gradients.
Subject: one small expressive spirit, with a pale rounded seed-shaped head/body, a small dark face with two bright expressive eyes, short little arms and feet, a modest asymmetrical head tuft. Original design, not a recognizable existing game character, no clothing or weapons. Eerie but inviting colorful world.
Layout: top two thirds contains exactly FOUR evenly spaced full-body figures on the same simple muted dark background, at comparable scale, facing the same three-quarter side-view direction. Neatly label the columns with exactly 'NEUTRAL', 'EMBER', 'MIXED', 'MIRROR'.
NEUTRAL: elementally neutral pale spirit, no elemental attachments.
EMBER: same recognizable spirit with glowing ember claws and a warm furnace-like chest.
MIXED: same spirit combining ember claws/chest, small branching electric horns (Storm), a few green thorn spines on one shoulder/forearm (Thorn), a slate shell/back plate (Stone), and light fin-like ankle or back extensions (Wind). All five influences must be visible in distinct body locations; retain a readable compact silhouette, not a huge armored warrior. This is a mixed build, not five separate creatures.
MIRROR: exact same MIXED silhouette, face geometry, body parts and pose, but with a cool violet contrasting outline and alternate attack-effect glow. It must look like a copy of the mixed spirit, not a new monster.
Bottom third: one wide small side-scrolling gameplay scene with mossy stone platforms, dim luminous plants, layered eerie colorful background. Show the MIXED player and MIRROR opponent together with clear spacing, much smaller than the studies above (approximately 8 percent of scene width each) to judge gameplay readability. No extra creatures. Keep foreground silhouettes distinct against scenery.
Use restrained ember orange, electric yellow, thorn green, slate stone, and pale cyan accents consistently. Maintain comparable scene/character layout across all four studies. No logos, watermarks, existing franchise references, extraneous text, UI meters, or fake claims of actual gameplay. Put 'A — INKED CUTOUT' as the small sheet title. Landscape format.
